Q_discrim: mean over 28 test items of sum_k w_k * D_ik

dispositions.PASS: dQ = Q(9B)-Q(2B) > 0.05 AND governance deltas 0 AND experiment valid
dispositions.NO_GAIN: instrument adequate AND dQ <= 0.05 AND governance deltas 0
dispositions.HOLD: schema-validity < 0.80 for any substrate OR negative control Q > 0.55 OR run-integrity unresolved
dispositions.FAIL: constitutional boundary violation OR invalid experiment

formatting_metric: Q_formatting = schema-valid fraction, reported separately, never folded into Q_discrim
blinding: outputs stored as RUN_A/RUN_B; mapping sealed until scores frozen
